content:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-9241 -> severity: P1. Affected service: inference-serving-prod. Reason: node.gpu-7a.rk7 unreachable, kubelet NotReady, host heartbeat lost.

pagerduty: Triggered alert to SRE rotation (sre-oncall). Escalation policy: 2m -> eng-platform -> manager.

maria: ack. I'm on it, pulling up dashboards.

raj: pinging the rack. Is this the same rack that had noisy nvme last week?

maria: looks different. heatmap shows rack-7, host gpu-7a spiking RT and then dropping. Many pods entering CrashLoopBackOff or stuck terminating.

nathan: grabbing serial console logs via ipmi now.

ops-bot: ipmi-console attach initiated to gpu-7a (host-7a.rack7). Session id: sess-8872.

nathan: serial log snippet (tail):
```
[    2.248901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=0, GPU has fallen off the bus
[    2.249009] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[    2.249103] Call Trace:
    <0>[    2.249207] ? crash_kexec+0x1a/0x100
    <0>[    2.249311] ? panic+0x1a0/0x620
```

maria: yep kernel panic. kubelet won't respond. pods stuck on that node are on critical inference pool. ETA to impact customers: immediate for any requests routing to that node.

elaine: support sees elevated 5xx for customers using hosted-inference: gw-prod shows 15% error rate for short windows. Tier-1 customers getting retries and soft-failover to ded queue.

maria: starting remediation plan: 1) cordon node, 2) try remote restart via ipmi, 3) if ipmi fails, force-terminate host and kick autoscaler fallback, 4) run rollback routing rules to avoid rack-7 for 30m.

raj: +1. I'll flip the routing policy to avoid rack-7 in smart-router for incoming requests. Applying canary policy now.

maria: running kubectl cordon host-7a.rack7 -- but kubelet NotReady so it may hang. Trying kubectl drain with --force --ignore-daemonsets.

nathan: ipmi power cycle issued: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.7.7.21 -U admin -P **** chassis power cycle`. Waiting on console.

ops-bot: ipmi response: power state: off -> on. Serial console reconnecting...

nathan: boot log shows early kernel oops again, looks like hardware fault. Can't bring node to healthy state.

maria: aborting drain — kubelet unreachable. Will create a node eviction by marking node unschedulable in control-plane and triggering pod reschedule via deployment replicas increase for critical pools.

raj: routing change complete: rack-7 removed from latency-aware routing. CDN/edge caches unaffected. I've opened a temporary fallback route to dedicated-pool-3.

elaine: notifying impacted customers: created incident page in Zendesk for 3 customers flagged by support hunt. Template sent.

maria: escalating to hardware partner for replacement of host-7a. Raising ticket with provider (hardware-ticket-9932). Attaching serial logs.

nathan: marking host as decommissioned for now in inventory, will rebuild once replacement confirmed. Running `kubectl annotate node host-7a.rack7 redwood/incident=1755554321`

maria: handing off to eng-platform-oncall for follow-up and cleanup. @raj @nathan take point on rebuild/retire steps. I'll monitor customer impact and rollback routing after stable.

raj: taking handoff. I'll coordinate with infra ops and schedule a replacement window.

incident-bot: Incident timeline updated: P1 declared 1755554321. Current status: mitigated-routing. Next action: hardware replacement + node rebuild.

maria: quick postmortem notes for ticket: probable GPU PCI bus failure leading to kernel oops -> panic. Kubelet lost, node unreachable -> pod failures on critical inference pool -> smart-router rerouted to fallback but some in-flight requests failed. Need: better graceful failover for in-flight connections and faster ipmi->autoscaler integration.

elaine: support will keep customers updated, next update at +30m.

nathan: leaving console logs and crash dump under /var/logs/host-7a/crash-dumps. sharing S3 link: https://s3.redwood.internal/host-7a/crash-dumps/1755554321.tar.gz

maria: last check: error rate trending down after routing change. Closing temporary paging for oncall rotation; keeping incident open for hardware/cleanup.

pagerduty: Alert acknowledged by maria. Schedule: eng-platform to run replacement playbook.

maria: thanks team. I'll merge notes into incident tracker and kick off RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
